content.comment_body: Hello all, I’m having trouble with my [product_name]. I set a password, but it looks like I entered it incorrectly. Now the system requests the LCS password. Is there any way to reset this? I’ve already attempted a factory reset but it didn’t resolve the issue. Thanks for any advice.
Which [product_name] are you using specifically (please provide the [article_no])? Can you clarify which password you mean?
My [product_name] is [article_no] [version_no]. The [product_name] software, [product_name] [version_no], is asking for the LSC password. I’ve attached a screenshot of the message.

You have a [product_name] without display. If the LSC access password has been set and forgotten, unfortunately there is no way to recover access. Without the password, you cannot connect via the LSC and a factory reset won’t help. You may find some discussion about this issue by searching for '[article_no] [product_name] - forgotten password'.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing complete lockouts when forgetting the password for accessing their [product_name] device. Even after trying a factory reset, the [product_name] software enforces strict access controls, and there is no official way to bypass or reset the LSC password once it’s set. This leads to frustration, indicating a need for improved credential recovery options to address lost password scenarios.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping for a method to regain access to their [product_name] after forgetting the LSC password, whether through a reset, recovery process, or official support.
